name: Leda Morcant
bio: Morcant treats every warning light as a negotiation. Kestrel's technicians have stopped asking how often she wins.

personality.label: Cocky negotiator
personality.description: Bargains with warning lights and winning odds. Cheerful until someone else is put at risk.

move: We have an agreement: it walks, I stop complaining.
Another small negotiation with the gearbox.
attack: I made an offer. They will hear it shortly.
guard: This patch is ours. Terms are firm.
investigate: Let us find out who is bargaining out there.
heavy_fire: The armour is asking for better terms. Cover me.
I am losing this negotiation. A little assistance?
